messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `auth-service` (jwt-validation) — High error rate observed for token validation endpoints. Pager: pd-ops@redwood.com
PagerDuty: Incident INC-3287654321 created and notified on-call.

Tom L.: ack. taking this — oncall for platform. triaging now.

Sara N.: saw customer reports on status page. Impact: login/timeouts for ~35% of requests to /v1/auth/validate. errors look like `kid` not found in JWKS.

Tom L.: same here. logs show `InvalidSignatureError: kid mismatch` and `NoMatchingKeyError` from jwt verifier. suspect JWKS rotation mismatch.

Alex C.: @Tom L. did we push a key rotation to the signer? I merged a PR to rotate key TTL at 15:12 UTC.

Tom L.: checking deploy history — `auth-signer` config changed at 15:14 UTC; new jwk kid `k_2026_03_15_b` issued at 15:14:10.

Derek: infra here — looks like CDN/edge caches still serving the old JWKS; some proxies have long TTLs. investigating cache invalidation options.

Tom L.: immediate mitigation: allow verifier to attempt previous JWKS if kid not found, short-term fallback. need a config toggle or hotfix.

Alex C.: I can push a verifier fallback quickly. prepping patch to enable `fallback_to_previous_jwks=true` and restart verifier pods.

Alex C.: hotfix applied to prod verifier config:
```yaml
jwks_cache:
  ttl: 300  # 5m
  fallback_allowed: true
```
Deploy command run: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/auth-verifier`

PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded by Tom L. Escalation paused.

Tom L.: rolling fix; monitoring metrics.

~30s later

Tom L.: error rate dropped to ~8% (from ~35%). still seeing failures from a subset of edge nodes.

Derek: kicked off CloudFront invalidation:
`aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2ABC... --paths \"/.well-known/jwks.json\"`
Estimate ~10m to finish propagation.

Sara N.: @support-team please draft customer note: Impact window, affected endpoints, mitigation status. Update status page: partial authentication failures starting 15:14 UTC; mitigation applied.

Support-bot: Created incident tracker entry INC-3287654321 and attached initial notes.

Alex C.: traces show eu-west-1 still returning old JWKS from local edge cache. Derek, can you confirm if any proxies still have 24h local cache?

Derek: yes — some legacy edge proxies had hardcoded cache ttl=86400. I pushed a reload and a targeted cache clear on those nodes.

Tom L.: monitoring now shows error rate <1% across regions. primary mitigation complete. keeping incident open for RCA and follow-ups (pipeline change, automation).

Sara N.: next steps: 1) RCA doc with timeline, 2) add pre-rotation invalidation step to deploy pipeline, 3) make verifier fallback a permanent, observable feature. Owners: Alex -> verifier fallback PR, Derek -> CDN invalidation automation, Tom -> RCA draft.

Tom L.: handing off to oncall: @Alex C. you're next. I'm available until 16:30 UTC for questions.

Alex C.: ack. will monitor. thanks.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3287654321 status updated: Mitigated (manual). Follow-up tasks created for RCA and deploy pipeline changes.

Sara N.: posting final update to status page and sending customer-facing note. :thumbsup:
